name: workspace

scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck

comment:optionalDependencies: Windows-only native binaries for local dev/build. pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides strip the win32 variants that rollup/lightningcss/tailwind pull transitively, so we re-add them here at the exact resolved versions. On Linux (deploy) these are skipped via their os field, and the linux-x64-gnu variants load normally.
